hypothesis: Keeping the EfficientNet-B1, fixed views, ordinary replacement mini-batches, BCE term, optimization budget, checkpoint rule and calibration unchanged, a bounded training-only penalty on VFT logits of the pre-specified SinFM+MFT+ISRJ, VFT-negative composition will improve difficult-negative separation without the response-amplification pattern observed in P8b.
single_changed_axis: C1 adds only the VFT hard-negative logit-cap term; C0 and C1 use exactly the same deterministic replacement batches for each model seed.

failure_attribution.observed_failure: VFT positive exposure increased but VFT 10 dB AUPR decreased and worst-power VFT FPR increased, hence the failure was response amplification rather than positive-negative separation.
failure_attribution.mechanistic_target: Suppress excessive VFT evidence only on the fixed false-positive composition while retaining ordinary BCE for every label and every row.

fresh_data.identity_contract: all nine power views of one receiver_noise_seed remain in exactly one role
must_not_overlap: all previously generated train identity pools under generated_data

training_manifest.combination_tail: even-cardinality nonempty combinations target 10 samples each; odd-cardinality combinations absorb remaining mass under exact label constraints
training_manifest.visibility_tail: VFT-positive identities coexisting with any fixed component receive one deterministic 10/15/20 dB view; all other identities use 30 dB

models.C0_random_BCE: efficientnet_b1_1d with ordinary replacement random mini-batches and BCEWithLogitsLoss
models.C1_random_BCE_plus_vft_hard_negative_log: same initial weights, same replacement random mini-batches, same BCE term and only the pre-specified cap penalty on VFT=0 and SinFM=MFT=ISRJ=1 rows

loss.hard_negative_definition: VFT=0 AND SinFM=1 AND MFT=1 AND ISRJ=1
loss.formula: BCE + 0.05 * mean(relu(logit_VFT - 0.0)^2) over hard-negative rows; zero extra term if a mini-batch has none

selection_and_calibration.checkpoint: highest early-stop macro-AUPR; ties resolve by VFT AUPR then lowest epoch
selection_and_calibration.threshold: per-class F1 grid on calibration role only; one frozen threshold set per model; no development retuning
selection_and_calibration.development: all nine powers, all 2520 held-out identities; paired views cluster by receiver_noise_seed

response_risk: VFT FPR by power and combination
VFT hard-negative FPR for VFT=0 and SinFM=MFT=ISRJ=1
metrics.separation: mean VFT probability on positives minus mean VFT probability on fixed hard negatives

stop_rule: If any development gate fails, permanently stop this exact cap mechanism on these identities. Do not alter penalty weight, cap, hard-negative definition, data roles, loss, thresholds, backbone, training budget or gates; do not generate confirmation identities. If it passes, freeze code and checkpoints, run the two pre-specified additional model seeds, then require two fresh identity-pool no-retuning confirmations before any locked-test request.
